title: Triage runs the step-pick check at each batch-merge review, from a fresh ArtifactData read, and the check refuses a stale answers file
why: Lane step-pick-claims-match-page 15:22 CST Nov 12: the check is built on pick a (a session feeds an answers file read with ArtifactData), but no step, skill or hook names which session runs it or when; the file's read time is printed, not checked for freshness.
note: Name triage as the runner in skill waiting-page and in the batch-merge review (plans/reweigh-2026-11-12.md "Repeat"): export the answers with ArtifactData, run the check, file each mismatch. The check refuses an answers file read more than a set time before the run (number from a measured gap, not guessed). Red first on an old read time. After the check's PR merges.
